messages:
Maya Patel: Quick pass needed — draft post in Notion: https://notion.so/redwood/post-spin-draft (please don't change headline in doc yet). Key asks: 1) voice + headline preference (A/B below), 2) one-sentence benchmark callout we can use in hero, 3) confirm webinar CTA and demo signup mapping to HubSpot form, 4) legal quick-pass. Need by EOD today. :pray:

Jordan Lee: reading now. Headline A and B lines posted below. A) 'Predictable LLM inference — now for every app.' B) 'Ship LLM features with enterprise-grade predictability.' Lean A for dev tone. :eyes:

Emily Chen: Figma hero updated — https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/hero. Suggest swapping screenshot to throughput graph. Quick design note: hero CTA needs primary 'Try Hosted API' and secondary 'Request Dedicated'

Sam Ortiz: For inbound routing — confirm HubSpot form id? Also want UTMs: use utm_source=launch, utm_medium=post, utm_campaign=postspin_v1. Recommend mapping 'Try Hosted API' -> hs_form_7788 -> assign SDR queue 'inbound-api'

Priya Rao: Legal quick-pass: watch language around 'always' and '100%'. Suggest 'consistent' in place of 'always'. Send me the bench numbers you plan to claim.

marketing-bot: SEO checklist complete — meta title/description present, og:image sized 1200x630, schema markup status: TODO

Jordan Lee: Benchmark callout suggestion: '2–3× lower p95 token latency vs baseline on our dedicated configs' (feel free to tighten after infra sign-off).

Sam Ortiz: HubSpot workflow snippet (copy for devs):
```
if form_submission == 'hs_form_7788':
  assign_queue('inbound-api')
  set_lead_source('postspin_blog')
```
Also add hidden fields: campaign=postspin_v1, offer=webinar

Emily Chen: Will update CTA visual states. Quick Q: Do we do an inline register modal or redirect to landing page?

Maya Patel: Redirect to landing page for tracking simplicity. Use modal only for demo requests later. Also webinar scheduled 2026-04-14 10am PT — Jordan you're host, Sam will own registration funnel.

Jordan Lee: Confirmed host. I'll draft speaker blurb and 1-sentence value prop for the registration page.

Priya Rao: Approve headline B with tweak: replace 'enterprise-grade' with 'production-grade' if we lean formal. Otherwise A needs 'predictable' defined.

Sam Ortiz: I'll wire the HS form today and set the workflow. Need the landing slug. Maya?

Maya Patel: landing slug: /post-spin. HubSpot form id hs_form_7788 is provisional — Sam great if you create and share GUID. Also UTM example to include in doc:
```
https://redwood.ai/post-spin?utm_source=launch&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=postspin_v1&utm_content=hero_cta
```

Emily Chen: Figma link updated with final hero and CTA — changed secondary to 'Request Dedicated' :thumbsup:

Jordan Lee: Added the benchmark sentence to the top of the doc. Ping infra for numbers.

Alex (infra): infra sign-off: p95 baseline numbers validated, you can claim '~2.1× lower p95 for common chat workloads' — send final phrasing to legal.

Priya Rao: OK with that phrasing. Final approve from me once the headline choice is confirmed.

Maya Patel: Thanks all. Action items: Jordan finalize speaker blurb (today), Sam create HS form + workflow + share GUID (today), Emily finalize hero and supply asset, Priya final legal sign-off once headline locked. I'll publish draft to content calendar, targeting publish Thursday. :calendar:

deploy-bot: scheduled publish job created: job-8971, scheduled for 2026-03-26T15:00:00Z (pending final signoffs).

Sam Ortiz: shared HS GUID: 0a1b2c3d-7788. Workflow in HubSpot created and assigned to 'inbound-api' queue. Quick test form submission worked.

Maya Patel: Received. Final ask — can someone do a quick read for tone? Jordan/Emily?

Jordan Lee: Quick read done. Small tweaks to intro for clarity. :sparkles:

Emily Chen: Visual QA done. All good from design. :white_check_mark:

Maya Patel: Priya? Final legal yes/no?

Priya Rao: Legal: approve with the agreed phrasing. Good to publish from legal side. :ok_hand:

Maya Patel: Perfect. I'll hit publish when the CMS checkbox is green. Thank you team. :raised_hands:
